description: The whole library as JSON: library directory and host; entry count and size on disk; per type (pmid, doi, dailymed, nct) the entries by level (full_text, abstract, title) and retractions; counts of retracted and not-citable entries and of errata, expressions of concern and updates; the retrieval sources in run order and which are off (tiers); the download ladder (download): the Playwright servers with the version they must run, the Chrome rungs, the Bright Data unlocker; the configuration and where each value came from — environment, .env or default, never the value (config); the decision model behind library_verify and whether it answers right now (verify); this server's cache hits and misses for library_verify and library_fetch since it started (cache). ids=true also lists every entry ID.
name: library_info
